verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads and @mentions on a message are a fair axis for an email service, so the story applies to Fastmail. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any internal commenting, side-thread or @mention feature. The listed features (filters, templates, snooze, scheduled send, masked email, JMAP API) do not cover team discussion of a message. The community mention of 'forwarding' refers to mail fetching, not collaboration.
